Maria Chen: Morning — quick alignment: we're running a small experimental design-partner run for Private Deploy. Need an intake that's <2min and a clear 'must' gate list. Target 6 partners, staggered.
Ibrahim Khan: Keep it simple: 3 scored fields + 2 hard gates. Scored: product fit, infra readiness, and feedback commitment.
Sophie Park: I'd weight product fit higher (40%), infra 35%, feedback 25%. Scores 1-5.
Ken O'Neill: Hard gates: can start within 30d AND partner can provide at least one engineer for weekly sync. If either is no, fail fast.
Zara Patel: For outreach copy: short bullets only. Example: "Private beta — 6 weeks feedback + 1 week integration. Weekly async + biweekly review. Need 1 eng + 1 product contact."
Maria Chen: Success signals proposed: >=70% session attendance, >=8 actionable items/partner in 6w, and at least one conversion to reserved within 90d.
Ibrahim Khan: Ops: I'll make a minimal single-GPU runbook and a 'test payload' checklist. Can tag pilot infra in monitoring.
Sophie Park: Feedback loop: weekly short notes in a shared sheet + 30m biweekly review. Require partner to run a 20-prompt eval monthly.
Ken O'Neill: Add risk label (low/med/high) and escalate high risk to SRE with 72h response SLA. ops-bot: created #dp-2087654321-ops channel.
Maria Chen: Next steps: Ibrahim -> runbook (EOW); Sophie -> intake + outreach (tomorrow); Ken -> monitoring checklist (tomorrow). Reconvene Fri 9am to finalize seed invites. Post quick updates here only. :thumbsup:
